description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys class, specifically testing Netflix key session management, including creation, selection, and closing of key sessions, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaKeysNetflixKeySessionTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for media key session tests, setting up mocks and MediaKeys instance.

methods.name: CreateKeySession
methods.description: Tests that createKeySession forwards request to IPC and updates KeyIdMap.

methods.name: SelectKeyId
methods.description: Tests that selectKeyId adds a KeySession to KeyIdMap.

methods.name: SelectKeyIdFailure
methods.description: Tests that selectKeyId fails when appropriate.

methods.name: CloseKeySession
methods.description: Tests that closeKeySession forwards request to IPC and updates KeyIdMap accordingly.
